items.information:
Konkurrencen er er åben for alle og egnet til nye.

items.name: For the Love of FMC 2027
items.information:
For the love of FMC 2027 will be held from **Saturday, February 13, 2027 at 15:00 UTC until Sunday, February 14, 2027 at 00:00 UTC**. Please pay attention to the date and time zone of your location.

Registration and locations can be found [here](https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/FortheLoveofFMC2027)

Locations may be added until **January 29, 2027 23:59 UTC** so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates).

Note: Registrations on the external website are up-to-date, but registrations will only be added to the WCA website periodically.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjIyNzAyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bd44f33bc27ff49ca1c9273454814525c04d0503/FortheLoveofFMC2027Logo.png)

items.name: Red Deer Favourites 2027

venue.name: Cenovus Common, Red Deer Polytechnic
venue.address: 100 College Boulevard, Red Deer, Alberta, Canada T4N 5H5
venue.details: Upstairs in the Cenovus Learning Common

items.information:
Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, **please arrive at least 15 minutes before the events that you compete in or help in are planned to start**. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in.

**First-Time Competitors: All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing.** There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s&ab_channel=cyotheking) for a basic overview of the rules.

items.name: Rocky Face 2027
items.information:
**Please note that outside food is not allowed in the venue.** If you would like to eat on-site, the venue will be operating a concession stand throughout the competition. Any food not purchased at that concession stand cannot be brought into the venue.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
